summary: Suspicious package name referencing MetaMask under unfamiliar scope
details: Package @wagni_bot/metamask@1.0.0 uses a scope and name that reference MetaMask, a widely-targeted crypto wallet brand, but no static or traced-code evidence of installer-side harm (credential theft, exfiltration, dropper, backdoor, silent-relay) is available from this analysis. The package contains only 3 files and no findings fired, so intent cannot be confirmed. Name-based confusion with the MetaMask project is a subjective signal warranting human review rather than automated blocking.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
